name: Survey tile in Virgo
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 2.6 degrees north of the ecliptic in Virgo, imaged by SPHEREx 12 times in 3 visits over 8 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 22 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 8 hours starting 2026-06-21, at wavelengths from 0.76 to 3.21 µm. The pipeline found 1 moving object.
